urls.rationale: 42.17A.005 Definitions — defines 'lobby/lobbying,' 'lobbyist,' 'lobbyist's employer,' and other terms used throughout the lobbying-reporting provisions.
42.17A.020 Statements and reports public records — establishes that filed reports (including lobbyist reports) are public records.
42.17A.120 Suspension or modification of reporting requirements — PDC authority that conditions when lobbyist reports may be modified.
42.17A.600 Registration of lobbyists — the central lobbyist-registration requirement.
42.17A.605 Photograph and information — booklet — publication of registered-lobbyist information.
42.17A.610 Exemption from registration — scope carve-outs from the lobbyist-registration regime.
42.17A.615 Reporting by lobbyists — periodic lobbyist activity/expenditure reports.
42.17A.620 Notification to person named in report — disclosure-notice obligations under the lobbyist-reporting regime.
42.17A.625 Special reports — lobbyists — late contributions or large totals.
42.17A.630 Reports by employers of registered lobbyists — disclosure obligations on lobbyist principals.
42.17A.635 Legislative activities of state agencies and elective officials — public-sector lobbying disclosure.
42.17A.640 Grass roots lobbying campaigns — indirect-lobbying disclosure requirement.
42.17A.645 Employment of legislators or state employees — disclosure of lobbyist-side employment relationships.
42.17A.650 Employment of unregistered persons — prohibitions tied to the lobbyist-registration regime.
42.17A.655 Lobbyists' duties, restrictions — penalties for violations.
42.17A.750 Civil remedies and sanctions — referral for criminal prosecution; chapter-wide enforcement reaching lobbyist provisions.
42.17A.755 Violations — determination by commission — penalties — procedure; chapter-wide enforcement.
42.17A.770 Limitation on actions — limitation period for enforcement of chapter violations including lobbyist-disclosure violations.

notes: Chapter 42.17A is the unified RCW chapter for both campaign-finance and lobbying disclosure. I included only lobbying-disclosure-specific sections plus chapter-wide support (definitions, public-records status, PDC modification authority, enforcement/penalties). Excluded: campaign-finance sections .100s–.500s except the chapter-wide administrative ones; personal-financial-disclosure sections .700–.715 (separate regime — officials' financial affairs/gifts, not lobbying); save-provision sections .900s (not statute body). Per-section-leaf convention (Wisconsin Example D shape).
